scenes.title: Le grenier
scenes.description: Luna cherche les vêtements d’hiver ; son agacement précède la découverte.
scenes.prompt:
Create the opening 30 seconds of an emotional Converse family-history commercial, a continuous hand-painted gouache/watercolor ANIMATED FILM on warm textured paper, landscape 16:9. Use cinematic cuts, natural acting, parallax depth and confidently animated limbs, not a slideshow, not a photorealistic movie, not glossy 3D. Preserve the distinctive painted style of the supplied reference images throughout. Image 2 is Rafa, the SAME fictional 16-year-old boy in 1970: dark short curls, white basketball tank, navy shorts, white tube socks with burgundy bands. Luna and Rafa NEVER merge. Image 3 is the D06 family attic location: exposed timber rafters, brick gable, left casement window, trunk and wooden floor, afternoon light. Image 4 is the 1970 Bronx basketball court. Image 5 is the inherited worn black adult high-top Converse in 2026 with modest wear and small right-side cream repair. Image 6 is the SAME classic black high-top pair in 1970 before wear or repair. Only inner ankles carry round badges; outer ankles are plain. No orange, no low-top silhouette, no platforms. Use the corresponding view within each sheet for the camera angle, keeping exactly one subject/pair in the scene.

0.0–1.0 black screen. 1.0–6.0 POV: attic door swings open, camera advances carefully between cluttered boxes, dust drifts through warm left-window light. Natural domestic mood, no funeral and no supernatural light beam.
6.0–10.0 medium-wide: Luna steps through the clutter, mildly annoyed. She moves a box aside, catches her toe against an old shoebox, stops and looks down. Mouth relaxed, dialogue will be dubbed offscreen, no lip-sync performance required.

scenes.title: Une question au téléphone
scenes.description: Luna photographie le tirage paysage puis attend une réponse qui ne lui apprend pas à connaître Rafa.
scenes.prompt:
A fully HAND-DRAWN AND HAND-PAINTED 2D GOUACHE ANIMATION on warm cotton paper, not live action. Every visible surface, especially FACES, is constructed from bold opaque matte brush shapes and sparse broken charcoal lines. Cheeks, forehead, nose, lips and eyelids have plainly visible bristle marks, angular warm/cool painted colour planes, paper grain showing in thin paint. Simplified painted eyes, irregular hand-drawn contours, subtle controlled line boil. Skin has the SAME graphic simplification and same brush size as clothing and scenery. Preserve recognizable character silhouette, proportions, hair, age and outfit from references, while interpreting the faces as drawings, not preserving photographic skin. Shading in 3-4 painted tones, not smooth gradients. No photorealistic facial cutouts, airbrushed skin, skin pores, cosmetic shine, glassy 3D eyeballs or soft plastic faces. Expressive restrained human acting; actually animate bodies and cloth, no static pan of an illustration. Paper texture remains anchored to artwork, faces do not melt or flicker. Single cinematic full frame 16:9, 720p. No titles, subtitles, music, speech or sound.

Luna age15, dark curly LOW ponytail, plain charcoal oversized T-shirt, solid olive cargo trousers, sits in the D06 attic beside the open battered shoe case. LEFT window, brick, rafters, painted warm light. She uses a modern black phone to photograph a small LANDSCAPE-ORIENTATION paper photograph of her young grandfather Rafa age16 in basketball clothes. Image 4 locks the EXACT physical photograph already seen in the preceding shot: a LANDSCAPE rectangular faded color print, width longer than height, worn cream paper border, FULL-LENGTH teenage Rafa in white tank, navy shorts, striped tube socks, black Converse on a Bronx playground with brick tenement walls and fence behind him, orange basketball at his side. It is a wide full-body historical snapshot, NOT a cropped portrait or a newly posed picture. Preserve the SAME image content, orientation, worn border and apparent paper proportions when Luna holds it and when it appears tiny on the phone screen. Luna holds this wide print in her left hand, never turns it into a portrait-oriented sheet. The print shows Rafa with ONE basketball on the 1970 court; he is ONLY inside the print, never a live person in the attic. 0–3s: over Luna's RIGHT shoulder, her LEFT hand holds the old sepia print upright, RIGHT hand holds the phone vertically aimed at it. The phone camera screen shows a tiny painted view of that same paper photograph. She presses its shutter once with right thumb. Both hands stable, normal fingers, no extra devices. 3–5s: cut to medium-close three-quarter view of her painted face; she brings the phone closer to her chest, curious eyes on it as though awaiting a reply. Her mouth remains at rest; offscreen dialogue will be added later. 5–8s: same framing, phone gives an unhelpful response implied by her eyes dropping and a restrained disappointed exhale, eyes never wide with surprise, no open-mouth gasp. She lowers the phone and looks back at the physical photo with tenderness. The phone remains a small diegetic prop, never full-screen UI. Screen is understated painted pale paper with two abstract grey line shapes, absolutely no legible text or generated lettering. Leave lower 15 percent of frame mostly dark plain torso/wood for concise editorial subtitles if needed. No AI holograms, neon, sci-fi portals or floating panels.
